summary: 本轮检索到 1 项 2026-08-26 首次公开且与灵巧手高度相关的新工作：一款五指腱驱动灵巧手，结合分布式双模态触觉感知，直接围绕灵巧操作本体设计。由于它给出了实体手实验和接受信息，因此纳入本次更新。
summary_en: This run found 1 newly public item from 2026-08-26 that is highly relevant to dexterous hands: a tendon-driven five-fingered hand with distributed dual-modality tactile perception, centered directly on dexterous-hand design. It includes physical manipulation experiments and acceptance information, so it is included in this update.

items.title: A Tendon-Driven Five-Fingered Hand with Distributed Tactile Perception for Dexterous Manipulation
items.relevance: 该工作把灵巧机器人手本身作为核心贡献，重点在五指腱驱动结构与分布式触觉感知的集成，而不是通用抓取或普通机械臂操控，因此与灵巧手硬件和触觉驱动灵巧操作直接相关。
items.relevance_en: This work makes the dexterous robot hand itself the core contribution, focusing on the integration of a five-finger tendon-driven structure and distributed tactile sensing rather than generic grasping or ordinary arm manipulation, so it is directly relevant to dexterous-hand hardware and tactile-driven dexterous manipulation.
items.novelty_signal: 2026-08-26 首次公开的 arXiv 论文，页面同时给出 ICoSR 2026 接收信息，并明确列出手势计数、指拇捏取、物体抓取和瓶体触觉记录等操作实验，属于新增且可验证的公开条目。
items.novelty_signal_en: A first-public arXiv paper on 2026-08-26 that also lists acceptance by ICoSR 2026 and explicitly reports manipulation experiments including counting gestures, finger-to-thumb pinching, object grasping, and bottle-grasp tactile recording, making it a new and verifiable entry.
items.analysis_zh: 这篇工作主要提出一种腱驱动五指灵巧手并集成分布式触觉感知；它要解决的是灵巧机器人手在灵巧度和触觉感知能力上的双重瓶颈，尤其是要同时兼顾柔顺性、输出力和接触感知。方法上，作者采用软-刚混合结构，并在五根手指的远端和中段指节上布置双模态触觉元件，使系统能够同时检测静态接触与动态力变化。实验包括手势计数、拇指-食指捏取、物体抓取以及瓶体抓取触觉记录，证明了该一体化执行-感知系统的可行性。公开摘要没有给出更细致的定量指标、对照基线或长时稳定性结果，因此目前更适合把它视作一项面向灵巧手本体设计与多点触觉集成的硬件型贡献，而不是已完成系统级性能闭环验证的成熟方案。
items.analysis_en: The main contribution is a tendon-driven five-fingered hand with distributed tactile perception. It addresses a core bottleneck in dexterous robotics: a hand must provide both sufficient dexterity and tactile sensing if it is to support complex manipulation, yet those two requirements are often hard to balance. The method uses a soft-rigid-hybrid structure to combine compliance with operational force, and places dual-modality tactile elements on the distal and middle phalanges of all five fingers so the system can detect both static contact and dynamic force variation. The experiments reported in the abstract include counting gestures, finger-to-thumb pinching, object grasping, and bottle-grasp tactile recording, which demonstrate the feasibility of the integrated actuation-perception system. The public summary does not provide detailed quantitative metrics, comparison baselines, or long-horizon stability data, so the current evidence supports treating it as a hardware-centric contribution to dexterous-hand design and tactile integration rather than a fully validated closed-loop manipulation system.
